text: Should the generated formatter honour MessagePack attributes (e.g. [MessagePackObject], [Key], [DataContract]) when they are present on T, as the requirement says?
options: Yes: honour attributes on T, and fall back to contractless only when none are present
No: ignore them, and use contractless mode or a surrogate only
why_it_matters: The requirement says that if T carries attributes they are honoured. The change ignores attributes on T entirely. If honouring is required, the change does not meet the requirement; if the surrogate design supersedes it, the current behaviour is fine.
